heading: INT. NEW BEGINNINGS FERTILITY CLINIC - WAITING ROOM - DAY

units.text: INT. NEW BEGINNINGS FERTILITY CLINIC - WAITING ROOM - DAY
We see a quiet waiting room with beige chairs and a fish tank.
The power has been out for three days after the storm, and the clinic is running on one generator.
We can tell this because the lights are dim and the fish tank is not bubbling.
CLOSE ON a clock on the wall.
It reads 2:14.
It is not moving.
Maya, 30s, sits very straight with her purse in her lap.
Beside her, Dev, 30s, is tapping his knee.
They are not talking.
We can tell they are not talking because there is no talking.
ON PHONE: Mom - where r u guys?? is it happening
Maya turns her phone face down on her thigh without answering.
A NURSE enters.
We see that she is carrying a clipboard.
She is young and looks like she has not slept since the storm began.
Maya Rosen?
units.name: NURSE

units.text: Yes. That's me.
units.name: MAYA

units.text: Dr. Okafor will see you now. Only you, though. Generator rules.
units.name: NURSE

units.text: I'm her husband.
units.name: DEV

units.text: I know, Mr. Rosen. I'm sorry.
units.name: NURSE

units.text: Dev sits back down.
He does not say anything.
His hand is still on Maya's arm.
Dev. It's okay.
units.name: MAYA

units.text: Yeah. Okay.
units.name: DEV

units.text: Maya stands and follows the nurse through a swinging door.
We see the door swing shut behind her.
Dev is alone.
He pulls out his phone and we see the screen.
ON PHONE: Dev: they only let her in. what do i do
ON PHONE: Mom: sit. be there. thats the job
He looks at the fish tank.
One fish is hanging at the surface, mouth opening and closing.
A WOMAN in a green raincoat enters from the street door.
She is soaked.
She looks at the empty reception desk, then at Dev, then back at the desk.
She does not sign in.
They're, uh... generator only. You might wait outside.
units.name: DEV

units.text: I'm not a patient.
units.name: THE WOMAN

units.text: Oh.
units.name: DEV

units.text: I'm here for the freezer.
units.name: THE WOMAN

units.text: What freezer?
units.name: DEV

units.text: She does not answer.
She walks past him toward the hallway marked STAFF ONLY.
We see Dev watch her go.
He stands, unsure, then follows at a distance.
